subject: Post-demo: Clearsight concurrency rehearsal & script handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Clearsight concurrency rehearsal & script handoff

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the customer-led performance rehearsal next week.

Summary of what we agreed on:
- Test ownership: Clearsight will run the load (k6 preferred). Redwood will provision a scoped test API key and a test project.
- SLO targets to validate during the rehearsal:
  * Non-streaming generate endpoint: p95 latency <= 150 ms, p99 < 350 ms at target throughput.
  * Throughput/concurrency: target sustain of 200 concurrent virtual users for 30 minutes (expected ~320 req/s; exact will depend on your script).
  * Streaming: support 50 concurrent streaming sessions; initial chunk latency < 250 ms and stable token throughput ~18 tok/s per stream.
- Ramp plan (proposal): 0 -> 200 concurrent over 10 minutes, sustain 30 minutes, cooldown 5 minutes.
- IP allowlist: Redwood needs the public IP ranges you'll run tests from.
- Test accounts & limits: we'll issue a scoped API key limited to the rehearsal project and quota; no production data will be used.

Attachments included for your convenience:
- redwood-k6-probe-template.js (k6 script template for token-based calls) (attachment)
- permission-form-Clearsight.pdf (standard rehearsal permission and safety checklist) (attachment)

Immediate asks for Clearsight before we provision:
1) Confirm test window(s) you prefer (we have capacity Mon 22 Sep or Tue 23 Sep, 10:00–14:00 PT windows available).
2) Send the public IP ranges you will originate tests from (one file is easiest).
3) Confirm which script you'll run (k6 template or your own Locust script) and whether you need any custom headers.

Next steps (internal): Marissa — I'll need an API key and a temporary project created once we get the IP list. Ben — can you prepare a scoped org-level key with the Rehearsal tag?

Thanks — I'll pause provisioning until we get your IP list and final window.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — that all looks good. Quick answers below: 

- Preferred window: Tue, 23 Sep, 10:00–13:00 PT (we prefer a slightly shorter window).
- We'll run k6 from our CI runners and also have a small Locust spot-check for streaming sessions.
- IP ranges: attached (originating from two GCP regions and our on-prem cluster). See attached file clearsight-ip-list.txt (attachment).
- DevOps contact is devops@clearsight.ai (cc'd). Alan will own the run and will coordinate ramp timing.

A couple of clarifications/questions from our side:
1) For streaming validation — do you have a recommended script that drives both session open + token pace? If so, we can adapt.
2) Will the scoped key permit both streaming and non-streaming endpoints? We prefer a single key for the rehearsal project.

We can sign the permission form once we have the API/key details.

Thanks,

Samantha — thanks for the quick reply and the IP list. A few follow-ups and what we'll provision once you confirm the window: 

Provisioning details (what Redwood will create once IPs and window are confirmed):
- Test project: a sandbox project named "clearsight-rehearsal-2025-09".
- Scoped API key: scoped to the rehearsal project, valid for 48 hours, limited to 500k tokens for safety. Key will allow both streaming and non-streaming generate endpoints.
- Temporary dashboard access with request/latency metrics for the session.

Recommended script guidance for streaming: use the attached k6 template — it contains an example that opens a streaming connection, sends a short prompt, and enforces token pacing. If you prefer Locust for streaming probes we can provide a short snippet that demonstrates how to throttle token emission.

Ramp plan confirmation: 0 -> 200 users over 10m, sustain 30m, cooldown 5m. If you want to shorten sustain to 20m given your window (10:00–13:00 PT) we can do 0->200/10m, sustain 20m, cooldown 5m and run a smaller follow-up the same afternoon for any extra checks. Please confirm.

Docs & links:
- k6 template + sample outputs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearsight-k6-scripts
- SLO reference: https://docs.redwood.com/slo-reference#streaming

Action items: 
- Samantha / Alan: confirm Tue 23 Sep, 10:00–12:00 PT (we'll only provision for the first 2 hours to keep tokens low) and confirm ramp plan (20m vs 30m sustain).
- Alan (DevOps): confirm if you need any NAT IPs or additional headers to be allowed.
- Marissa: please prepare the sandbox project and a prefilled permission form we can send that Samantha can sign online.
- Ben: hold on key provisioning until I confirm the final window.

Thanks — aim is to have keys and allowlist done by Monday EOD.
